subject: ela
skillName: Point of View and Cultural Experience
intro: Analyze point of view and cultural experience.

items.prompt:
Literature from a particular culture reflects that culture's:
A) values and viewpoint
B) page count
C) font

Reading literature from other countries broadens your:
A) perspective
B) handwriting
C) shoe size

Whose eyes a story is told through is its:
A) point of view
B) title
C) length

A novel shows a character disgraced for a minor slight to the family. This reflects a culture that highly values:
A) family honor
B) individual wealth only
C) nothing

Why read literature from OUTSIDE your own country?
A) to understand viewpoints and experiences from other cultures
B) to avoid new ideas
C) to read less
items.answer: A) to understand viewpoints and experiences from other cultures

solution.answer: A) to understand viewpoints and experiences from other cultures

items.prompt:
A story told entirely from a colonized people's point of view:
A) foregrounds their experience and challenges the dominant view
B) must be false
C) has no point of view
items.answer: A) foregrounds their experience and challenges the dominant view

solution.answer: A) foregrounds their experience and challenges the dominant view

items.prompt:
Read.

A folktale repeatedly rewards the humble youngest child and punishes the proud elders.

The cultural value this BEST reflects is:
A) that humility is prized over pride
B) that elders are always right
C) that wealth is all that matters
items.answer: A) that humility is prized over pride

steps: Pattern reveals the value. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) that humility is prized over pride

items.prompt:
Analyzing the cultural experience in world literature mainly helps a reader:
A) understand values and perspectives different from their own
B) assume all cultures are identical
C) ignore the setting
items.answer: A) understand values and perspectives different from their own

steps: Builds cultural awareness. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) understand values and perspectives different from their own
